mathematical_definition: (std_interarrival - mean_interarrival) / (std_interarrival + mean_interarrival) -- Goh-Barabasi burstiness coefficient of tick inter-arrival gaps within TickActivityTracker's trailing 60s ring buffer (self._times); ranges toward -1 for regular/periodic arrivals and toward +1 for bursty/clustered arrivals
numerical_stability_notes: Stateful: derived from self._times, the same tick-timestamp deque that self._spreads is kept in lockstep with (both appended together on every update() call, both evicted together once a tick ages out of the trailing TICK_WINDOW_SEC=60.0s window). 0.0 returned (not a raw division) whenever (std + mean) <= 1e-12 to avoid a divide-by-near-zero blow-up during a degenerate all-identical-timestamp stretch. Genuinely new for Task 21 (spec section 7) -- the 6.7-year historical CSV has no tick-level timestamp series, so this feature has no historical analogue and cannot be backfilled.
missing_value_policy: None until at least 3 ticks are in the trailing 60s window (need at least 2 interarrival gaps to define both mean and std), never zero-filled
status_reason: no historical evidence exists or can exist for this feature; live data only since 2026-08-18 (Phase 2 live verification date)
